title: [finding] collect-docs.ts's module header states the retired ADR-0048 claim as the live justification — the same file declines that sentence 900 lines below
body:
Path: none | 写给 AI 的文档说错一句(北极星「优先级」4) | `collect-docs.ts` 的模块头把 ADR-0048 已退役的说法当作现行理由,同文件 900 行后自己否掉它
分诊重测与定级:2026-09-20T15:44Z

Filed by the `domain:cli` execution PM seat (#6024, session `session_01QCdUBjM47SxioST9z5Zwdf`) out of the #19248 round (PR #19352), where it arrived as a **read-only prose sweep** the seat commissioned after the docs-drift check disclaimed coverage. ⛔ Filed bare: `finding` only; `domain:*`, type and priority are triage's.

Dedupe words: `collect-docs.ts header docblock` · `registry key carries no package coordinate` · `silently overwrites across packages` · `ADR-0048 §1.1 vs §3.4`.

## The shape — one file, two answers

`packages/cli/src/utils/collect-docs.ts`. Both read verbatim from `origin/main`.

**The module header** gives the retired claim as the live justification for the naming lints:

> **Lint**: namespace-prefix naming (doc uniqueness is logical — the metadata registry key carries no package coordinate, so a **bare-name collision silently overwrites across packages**)

**Line 929 of the same file** declines that exact sentence, by name:

> ⚠️ The REASON is authoring hygiene, and ⛔ deliberately not *"one silently overwrites the other at registration"*. That sentence is this module's older framing and ADR-0048 retired it.

⭐ **So the correction is already in the file — it just never reached the top of it.** The header near-quotes ADR-0048 **§1.1**, a *context* heading that the ADR's own §3.1 / §3.3 / §3.4 then overturned. Reading the ADR from the top and stopping early reproduces exactly this error.

## Why it was not fixed in the round that found it

⛔ **Out of the #19248 order's declared file surface**, which fenced the work to *"the `docs/duplicate-name` message and its docblock only"*, with *"stop on breach"*. The dev obeyed the fence and reported instead — ⭐ the correct call, and worth recording: it also flagged that its own standing "bounded in-place fix" habit pointed the other way, rather than quietly picking the side it preferred.

⚠️ There is a second, better reason to keep it separate: the header sentence justifies **`docs/namespace-prefix` as well**, not only `docs/duplicate-name`. Rewriting it is a judgement about a **second rule** — which is precisely the kind of smuggling #19248 was opened to prevent.

## Why it should still be cheap

The corrected phrasing is already pinned ~900 lines below in the same file, so the wording does not have to be re-derived — only carried up and checked against the second rule it also covers.

## Related, ⛔ not the same card

`skills/objectstack-ui/rules/pages.md` carries the same retired claim in the customer-published skill catalog (Tier H). Filed separately — different surface, different tier, different owner.
